Question 8
?

Which of the following gives the line integral of the function f(x,y)=x+y along a circle of radius 4, traversed from the point (−4,0) to the point (4,0), as shown above?

a
16∫π2π(cos⁡t+sin⁡t)dt
b
4∫π2π(cos⁡t+sin⁡t)dt
c
16∫π2π(cos⁡t−sin⁡t)dt
d
4∫0π(cos⁡t−sin⁡t)dt
e
16∫0π(cos⁡t+sin⁡t)dt
